title: Implement ShoppingList Mutations
description: Add focused line-based mutation helpers for checklist items: toggle checked state, append unchecked items, and remove checklist lines while preserving all non-targeted Markdown byte-for-byte.
acceptance_criteria: `toggle(itemAt:)` flips only the bracket character on checklist lines and is a no-op for non-item lines.
`appendItem(_:)` appends exactly `- [ ] <itemText>\n`, inserting a newline first when needed.
`removeItem(atLine:)` removes the targeted checklist line including its trailing newline and is a no-op for non-item lines.
Untouched document content remains byte-identical after each mutation.
